name: Natívny UI prvok (pattern interrupt)
summary: Reklama vyzerá ako natívny prvok telefónu — notifikácia, DM, poznámka, vyhľadávací riadok. Prelomí bannerovú slepotu.
when_to_use: Urgency a announcement (nová zľava ako notifikácia), pripomienky, problem framing cez vyhľadávací dopyt.
prompt_block: Render the image as a pixel-accurate mobile interface element floating over a simple background: a system notification card, a messaging thread bubble, a notes-app page or a search autocomplete bar. The UI element is reproduced with believable system typography, correct corner radii, a subtle elevation shadow and a faint translucent material fill, so it reads as a genuine screen capture rather than a designed graphic. Background behind the element is either one flat brand colour or a heavily blurred lifestyle photograph with no readable detail. Everything outside the UI element stays quiet and empty. The canvas itself is full-bleed artwork, not a screenshot of a phone.
never: a phone bezel, device frame or mockup hand holding a phone
platform chrome such as Reels, Stories or TikTok overlays
decorative ad graphics, badges or starbursts around the UI element
more than one UI element in frame
